agents.name: Orchestrator
agents.role: Receives initial prompt, plans by spinning up specialists, synthesizes results.

planning_artifacts.shape: A progress indicator 'Specialist agents - X/3 completed' and individual panels for each specialist agent showing their status (Running/Complete) and a list of tools called with checkmarks.
lifecycle: Three 'researcher' panels appear, all marked 'Running' with 'Working...' status.
Individual tool calls (grep, ls, glob) are listed within each researcher panel and marked with a green checkmark upon completion.
As each researcher completes its task, its panel status changes from 'Running' to 'Complete'.
The overall progress indicator updates: '1/3 completed', '2/3 completed', '3/3 completed'.

ui_grammar.panel_positions: Main chat input at the bottom, chat history above it. Agent activity (specialist agent panels) appears below the main chat history. A static 'Quickstart' section is present at the very bottom.
ui_grammar.list_styles: Tool calls within agent panels are presented as a list with green checkmarks indicating completion. The final comparison is presented with bullet points.
ui_grammar.working_states: Agents show 'Running' tags, 'Working...' text, and an animated ellipsis (...) during active processing. Tool calls are listed and checked off as they complete. A progress bar/text 'X/3 completed' indicates overall task progress.

steering_moments.human_action: Clicks on the suggested prompt 'Compare DeepAgents, LangChain, and LangGraph for building an agent'.
